title: Pain de Mie (Square Sandwich Loaf)
summary: A milk and butter dough baked in a lidded Pullman tin, then uncovered to colour the crust.
equipment: 33 x 10 x 10 cm lidded Pullman tin

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Mix everything except the tin butter and knead 10 min until smooth and elastic.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave about 1-1½ h until doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Butter the tin and lid. Press the dough into a 30 cm rectangle, roll up tightly from a short side and set seam-down in the tin.

steps.title: Prove
steps.text: Cover and leave 45-60 min until the dough is 1 cm below the rim; slide on the lid. Heat the oven to 175 °C (155 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 25 min with the lid on, then remove the lid and bake 10-20 min more until golden and the centre reads 88 °C.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Turn out at once and cool completely on the rack before slicing.

tips: Let the dough rise to 1 cm below the rim before closing the lid.
Turn out at once so the sides stay crisp.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature for up to 3 days, or slice and freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
